threadTitle: Things that instantly reveal you just moved here
body: You still wait for a bus like it’s on time, instead of checking your phone for the next arrival—and it’s always late.
Heard a guy on the 196 bragging about finding a bag of cash in a park. Sketchy vibes but the way he told it, you’d think it was a film plot.

threadTitle: When you knew you were actually living here
body: When I saw the guy at the corner café crafting an espresso while discussing the latest BVG strike with a complete stranger. That’s Neukölln for you.

threadTitle: Things Berlin does that nowhere else does
body: Only in Berlin can you ride a tram while sharing a seat with someone’s pet iguana. It’s weirdly charming and part of the city’s quirky vibe.

threadTitle: Real signs someone is from here vs just working here
body: You know someone’s a local when they can name all the taco trucks on 24th St without blinking, but a visitor still thinks ‘taco truck’ means a food court.

threadTitle: Muni moments that define this city
body: Caught the N-Judah today; a guy serenading commuters with a ukulele. Only in the Tenderloin would you find a pop-up concert at 8 AM.

threadTitle: Things tourists get wrong about living here
body: Tourists think Gràcia is just the park and pretty squares, but the real vibe is in the tiny, tucked-away bars where locals sip vermut and chat for hours.

threadTitle: How to spot a recent arrival
body: You can tell a recent arrival by their hesitation at the pedestrian crossings; they still wait for the light even when locals just dash across.

threadTitle: Things that instantly reveal you just moved here
body: You say 'the Tube' instead of 'the underground' and look confused when locals don't flinch at delays.
Last night on the 333, a guy in a full suit tried to impress everyone with magic tricks. Ended up pulling a half-eaten sandwich from his pocket instead.

threadTitle: When you knew you were actually living here
body: I knew I was living in Neukölln when I saw a guy in a tutu juggling flaming torches outside the Kottbusser Tor U-Bahn station. Just another Tuesday.

threadTitle: Things Berlin does that nowhere else does
body: Only in Berlin can you find a club inside a former beer factory, where you dance on a floor made of old beer crates. It's oddly charming and totally unique.

threadTitle: Real signs someone is from here vs just working here
body: A local will quietly assess if the taco truck’s serving up lengua before even glancing at the menu; the newcomers will be awkwardly scanning for reviews.

threadTitle: Muni moments that define this city
body: Caught the 31 on Jones—only passenger shouting at the driver about his 'bad karma'. We just rolled our eyes, but honestly, we all felt it.

threadTitle: Things tourists get wrong about living here
body: Tourists think they can pop into a bar at any hour. Many local spots close by 11 PM, especially during the week. It's not a 24-hour city, despite the vibe.

threadTitle: How to spot a recent arrival
body: You can tell a recent arrival by their struggle to navigate the metro's ticket machines; they always seem to push the wrong buttons, holding up the line.
